summary_1line: Narada teaches Bhishma that gifts of food are the greatest charity, sustaining life, earning merit, and benefiting both giver and receiver in this world and the next.

image_candidates.scene_text: A weary traveler stands at a house door while the householder respectfully offers him a bowl of fresh food.
A Brahmana guest sits in a humble home receiving the first portion of a meal while the host family serves him reverently.
Narada, radiant and celestial, speaks before Bhishma and Yudhishthira about the sacred power of food sustaining the universe.
